sections.headline: Your AI Agent. Your Hardware. Your Auditable Memory.
sections.sub: Prime-Silo is a browser-first agent runtime that replaces ephemeral chat context with a permanent, auditable tri-graph cognitive mesh. Run state-of-the-art local models with cryptographic governance and zero cloud leakage.

sections.headline: Why Modern AI Workflows Break Down at Scale

cards.title: Write-Only Agent Memory
cards.body: Traditional AI agents suffer from amnesia. They discard context after every session or dump unstructured chat transcripts into flat databases that degrade over time.

cards.title: Cloud Privacy & Metered Cost
cards.body: Sending sensitive IP, proprietary codebases, and executive thinking through metered cloud APIs exposes your organization to ongoing privacy hazards and recurring operational spend.

cards.title: Hallucinated Knowledge Layers
cards.body: Unverified vector search retrieves fragmented paragraphs out of context, forcing models to stitch together hallucinated answers without clear source provenance.

cards.title: Unauditable AI Decisions
cards.body: When autonomous agents execute tools or modify files without cryptographic signatures and verifiable execution lineage, security audits become impossible.

sections.headline: Generated vs. Guaranteed
sections.intro: Language models are probabilistic reasoning engines—they excel at synthesis but cannot guarantee determinism. Prime-Silo draws a strict boundary between what the model generates and what the underlying runtime guarantees.

left.label: The LLM Generates
items: Natural language reasoning and candidate hypotheses
Semantic entity extraction across document streams
Code refactoring and creative problem solving

right.label: Prime-Silo Guarantees
items: Deterministic knowledge graph derivation without model drift
HMAC-signed execution manifests for every tool invocation
Precise source citation linked to exact file coordinates
Complete auditability with cryptographic lineage chains

sections.outro: Never trust an agent whose memory you cannot inspect, verify, and own end-to-end.

steps.label: One Unified Mesh
steps.body: Prime-Silo unifies three distinct knowledge domains into a single interconnected graph, eliminating silos between documentation, source code, and historical agent memory.

steps.label: Documents Graph
steps.body: Structured ingestion parses markdown, specifications, and whitepapers into discrete, citation-backed semantic concepts and relationships.

steps.label: Code Graph
steps.body: Tree-Sitter AST extraction maps function signatures, module imports, class definitions, and architectural dependencies across your entire codebase.

steps.label: Memory Graph
steps.body: Memo-Ray tracks every historical agent interaction, decision rationale, and outcome across sessions as structured, queryable memory cards.

steps.label: CORRELATES_WITH Overlay
steps.body: An enrichment overlay dynamically computes CORRELATES_WITH edges between documents, code symbols, and past decisions—allowing your agent to traverse deep dependencies instantly.

sections.headline: Six Primitives Every Workflow Stands On
sections.intro: Prime-Silo is not a bundle of features — it is a small set of load-bearing primitives that every workflow composes. Build them once, honestly, and each new capability costs less than the last.

items.name: Session Memory Store
items.body: Memo-Ray X-rays every agent session — across Claude Code, Antigravity and opencode — into one queryable timeline store instead of write-only logs.
items.unlocks: Long-horizon anything: you cannot collate what you never kept.

items.name: Local-Model Orchestration
items.body: One router in front of LM Studio, Lemonade and Ollama with an offline guard; models are env-profile driven, never hardcoded.
items.unlocks: Bulk cognition at electricity prices — and eval sweeps by swapping one variable.

items.name: Deterministic Graph Substrate
items.body: A single Source → Concept graph schema shared by documents, code and memory — derived deterministically wherever the entities are already known.
items.unlocks: Cited knowledge with no hallucination surface where it matters.

items.name: Signed Manifests & Honest Ledger
items.body: HMAC-SHA256 on every manifest; an append-only ledger that records failures as plainly as successes; CLP lineage end to end.
items.unlocks: Trust: every claim traceable, every run auditable, every gap visible.

items.name: Resume-Safe Execution
items.body: Phase checkpoints, per-item caches, reconcile-on-restart and halt-on-fault — a killed run resumes exactly where it stopped.
items.unlocks: Multi-day workflows on consumer hardware that survive sleeps, crashes and wedged engines.

items.name: Portable Workspaces
items.body: Isolated, disposable workspaces under one portable home — the whole runtime ships zero-install on six platforms.
items.unlocks: Clean experiments, honest A/B corpora, and the same stack on any machine.

sections.headline: LONGVIEW: Session Management & Collation at Machine Scale

steps.label: Inventory & Collation
steps.body: Sessions from every agent tool — Claude Code, Antigravity, opencode — are swept from their scattered logs into one queryable memory store: 248 sessions become a single governed corpus.

steps.label: Extract
steps.body: Each session is rendered into a deterministic evidence pack — no model involved, byte-for-byte reproducible, thin sessions flagged and skipped honestly.

steps.label: Map
steps.body: A local model walks every session timeline in bounded windows and distils structured cards — decisions, outcomes, failures, concepts — with per-card ledger entries and resume-safe caching.

steps.label: Deterministic Graph
steps.body: Cards become the knowledge graph without a second model pass: entities the map already extracted are derived straight into cited Source → Concept triples at ~0.4s per card.

steps.label: Enrich
steps.body: Duplicate concepts merge into cross-session hubs — the moment isolated sessions become one connected body of institutional knowledge.

steps.label: Deliver & Top-Up
steps.body: Reports, dossiers, a print-ready book woven along cross-project narrative arcs, even a locally-narrated audiobook — then delta runs keep the corpus current by collating only new sessions.

proofStats.note: Cross-project arcs lift book coverage from 31.4%

sections.sub: Every agent session you have ever run is raw material. LONGVIEW collates months of scattered history into one governed corpus, distils it with local models, and derives a cited knowledge graph — resume-safe across days, honest about every failure, live-metered with an earned ETA.

steps.label: Sealed Execution Runs
steps.body: Every agent execution is enclosed in an immutable runtime envelope that records inputs, parameters, and environment state.

steps.label: Structured Manifests
steps.body: JSON manifests capture exact tool calls, modified file hashes, and model configurations for reproducible verification.

steps.label: HMAC-SHA256 Signatures
steps.body: Cryptographic HMAC signatures seal every transaction log, preventing tampering or unauthorized modification.

steps.label: CLP Lineage Chain
steps.body: Complete Data Lineage Protocol (CLP) tracking links downstream file mutations directly to their upstream source prompt and model — rendered as an OpenLineage DAG with a per-artifact ontology and a workspace-grouped execution register.

steps.label: Sovereign Memory Teleport
steps.body: Sensitive sessions are labelled, then teleported — never deleted — into an isolated workspace, moving files, graph nodes, and vector chunks together, journalled and reversible, with a leak gate on every deliverable.

sections.headline: The Lineage Mesh: Every Artifact Traceable to Its Source
sections.sub: The same directed graph the runtime records is the one you can see: session to card to graph to book to PDF, each edge cited, sealed, and reversible — the marketing diagram is the real lineage, not an illustration.

steps.label: Session → Card
steps.body: Every raw session becomes a cited card. The first edge of the provenance graph is drawn deterministically — no model guesswork, byte-for-byte reproducible.

steps.label: Card → Graph
steps.body: Cards derive into Source → Concept triples: the knowledge graph, where every node traces back to the exact session that produced it.

steps.label: Graph → Book, Sealed
steps.body: Synthesis assembles the book from the graph, and the HMAC-SHA256 seal stamps the manifest — binding inputs to outputs so the chain cannot be forged.

steps.label: End-to-End CLP
steps.body: The Complete Lineage Protocol links every downstream artifact — PDF, section, individual claim — back to its upstream prompt and model, with a clean leak gate on every deliverable.

steps.label: Sovereign Teleport
steps.body: Sensitive sessions lift out of the mesh into an isolated workspace — provenance and vectors intact — moved, never deleted, and quarantined from every shared artifact.

sections.headline: The Document Forge: 21,000 Grounded Words From One Command
sections.sub: One CLI turns everything the estate knows - memory graphs, RAG indexes, code graphs, raw data, the code itself - into an enterprise architecture document: every diagram generated from graph truth, every section cited and gated, with an earned ETA that tells you the truth.

steps.label: Five sources, one truth
steps.body: Memory graph, RAG index, Tree-Sitter code graph, raw workspace data, and the source code itself light up as evidence lanes. Nothing in the document exists that did not flow from one of them.

steps.label: Evidence, not vibes
steps.body: Every lane converges into a citable evidence pack: 23,080 concepts, 33,402 code entities, 33,967 correlations - each with a label the writer must cite inline.

steps.label: The index plans itself
steps.body: A TOGAF-prescribed skeleton is the floor; a recursive planner expands each chapter into sub-sections and leaf nodes. Prescribed artifacts can be extended, never dropped.

steps.label: Leaf-node governance drives the ETA
steps.body: Each leaf is written against its evidence bundle and gated: word floor, inline citations, references block. Measured pace per leaf feeds an earned ETA - predicted completion landed within six minutes of reality.

steps.label: The epic lands, realized
steps.body: 21,111 words, 49 sections, 11 diagrams rendered to real SVG in the PDF - zero gate failures. Markdown, HTML and print PDF from the same build, byte-for-byte repeatable.

steps.label: Lineage without Marquez, grouped your way
steps.body: The runtime emits real OpenLineage events straight to an integrity-hashed ledger - no lineage server to run. Group the execution register by output produced, by commit, or by workspace: you define the lineage view your process needs.

sections.headline: An Agent OS That Gets Smarter With Every Session
sections.body: Unlike ephemeral chatbots that reset to zero every morning, Prime-Silo compounds institutional knowledge over time. Every task executed enriches the tri-graph mesh; every LONGVIEW run synthesizes new patterns; and every signed manifest strengthens your audit trail. The result is a sovereign engineering partner that is greater than the sum of its parts.

items.q: Is my data or code ever sent to external cloud servers?
items.a: No. Prime-Silo runs entirely on your local machine by default. All knowledge graphs, session transcripts, and files remain on your disk under your direct control. Outbound network requests occur only if you explicitly configure an external cloud provider.

items.q: What hardware do I need to run Prime-Silo locally?
items.a: Prime-Silo runs comfortably on Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4 with 16GB+ unified memory) or Windows/Linux systems with an NVIDIA or AMD GPU (8GB+ VRAM recommended for 7B-12B models). For lower-powered hardware, it can orchestrate lightweight quantizations or LAN servers.

items.q: Which local LLM engines are supported?
items.a: Prime-Silo connects seamlessly to LM Studio, Lemonade, Ollama, and standard OpenAI-compatible local endpoints. You can swap models per task without altering your underlying knowledge graph.

items.q: How does the Tri-Graph differ from standard RAG wrappers?
items.a: Standard RAG simply splits text into vector chunks. Prime-Silo builds a deterministic semantic graph linking documentation, Tree-Sitter syntax trees (ASTs), and historical agent memories via explicit CORRELATES_WITH relationships—enabling precise structural reasoning.
Yes. Prime-Silo core modules and browser runtime are open-source under the MIT License, ensuring transparency and freedom from vendor lock-in.

items.q: Can my organization audit Prime-Silo's actions?
items.a: Yes. Every tool execution and file modification generates an HMAC-signed manifest and Data Lineage Protocol (CLP) record, creating an unforgeable chain of custody for compliance reviews.
